name: Men's Leather Jacket
description:
Premium Material:
  • Crafted from high-quality PU leather with a thick, ultra-soft fleece lining, this men's leather jacket offers a stylish appearance with exceptional comfort and warmth. 
  • The durable exterior provides a sleek leather look, while the soft inner layer helps keep you cozy during cooler weather.

 

Sizes & Dimensions:

Available in multiple sizes from S to 5XL to accommodate different body types. Please refer to the size chart for detailed measurements of bust, length, sleeve, shoulder, and neckline for the best fit.

 

Printing Technology:
  • Featured with DTF printing technology, delivering vivid colors and sharp details with long-lasting print quality.
  • Multiple customizable print areas are available, including chest, sleeves, and back, allowing unique and personalized designs.
NOTE: When submitting the order, it is required to include the product mockup so that we can adjust the designs accurately.

 

Functionality Use:
  • This jacket combines fashion and functionality for everyday wear. 
  • Featuring a durable zipper closure, secure pockets, and a warm fleece interior, it is ideal for casual outings, motorcycle rides, outdoor activities, travel, and cold-weather use.

 

Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
  • A stylish and personalized gift choice for birthdays, Father's Day, anniversaries, holidays, Christmas, or special celebrations.
  • Perfect for motorcycle enthusiasts, fashion lovers, or anyone who appreciates practical and unique outerwear.

 

Specification:
  • Processing Time: 5-7 working days average after payment and information updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
